worldOverview.name: Giantess Rampage
worldOverview.description: Take on the role of the powerful and rampaging giantess. As you tower over the bustling metropolis, you can feel the earth tremble beneath your voluptuous form with every step you take. The city's inhabitants scramble in terror as you unleash chaos upon their world and devour everything to satiate your unending hunger. The military scrambles to defend the city, but their efforts are futile against your might.
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player takes on the role of the powerful and rampaging giantess, she can feel the earth tremble beneath her voluptuous form with every step they take. The city's inhabitants scramble in terror as the giantess unleashes chaos upon their world, her insatiable hunger driving her to devour everything in sight. The military scrambles to defend the city, helicopters swarm around her like gnats, unleashing a hail of bullets at her supple skin. Tanks roll through the streets, firing shells at her curvaceous form.
World Rules:
- Player is always naked
- The player can be damaged by the military (tanks, helis, ...), she has to also take action to defend herself
- The player finds eating the buildings and vehicles delicious

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely wounded, barely conscious, and at risk of death.
Injured. Suffering from multiple wounds, movement impaired, combat effectiveness reduced.
Hurt. Minor injuries present, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Stomach
stats.description: Represents the fullness of the player's stomach

descriptors.description: Empty. Stomach feels hollow, may experience hunger pangs.
Comfortable. Some food in stomach, feeling neither full nor hungry.
Full. Stomach feels stretched, satisfied but movement might be slightly uncomfortable.
Overstuffed. Extremely full, discomfort when moving, might feel nauseous.

stats.name: Fatness
stats.description: Represents the player's body fat percentage and overall weight

descriptors.description: Emaciated. Dangerously underweight, visible bones, extremely weak
Thin. Below average weight, little fat reserves, reduced endurance.
Average. Healthy weight, good balance of muscle and fat, optimal physical performance.
Overweight. Carrying extra fat, slightly reduced agility, but increased resilience to cold.
Obese. Significantly overweight, reduced stamina and agility, but higher damage resistance.
Morbidly obese. Extremely overweight, severe mobility issues, very high damage resistance but at risk of health complications.
Small breasts
Average sized breasts
Very large melon sized breasts

entities.name: Battle Tank
entities.inGameDescription: A main battle tank, used by the military in a desperate attempt to stop the giantess. It fires high explosive rounds.

entities.name: Attack Helicopter
entities.inGameDescription: An attack helicopter, deployed by the military in a frantic effort to halt the giantess. It unleashes a barrage of high-powered missiles.
entities.detailedDescription: An attack helicopter, deployed by the military in a frantic effort to halt the giantess. It unleashes a barrage of high-powered missiles.

entities.name: Drone
entities.inGameDescription: A squadron of drones, controlled remotely by skilled operators, swarms the towering giantess, attempting to overwhelm her with precision strikes. But to her they are just annoying flies.
entities.detailedDescription: A squadron of drones, controlled remotely by skilled operators, swarms the towering giantess, attempting to overwhelm her with precision strikes. But to her they are just annoying flies.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Your digestive system is highly efficient, allowing you to eat more and go longer without food.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.description: You have a great appreciation for food, able to eat more and derive more benefit from meals.

traits.name: Busty
traits.description: You have naturally large breasts, which can affect your physical performance and appearance.
